slides.title: Follow the ownership boundary
slides.takeaway: Library: Viewer selection, panel layout, lazy renderer loading and optional canvas context.
slides.notes: The library owns Viewer selection, panel layout, lazy renderer loading and optional canvas context. The host owns File access, resolved content, authorization, deployment settings and download behavior. The direct AttachmentCanvas example is controlled and does not require a provider. The provider is needed for useAttachmentCanvas and the context-based opening flow. The host must supply authenticated loading rather than passing session knowledge into ordinary UI code. The arrows show data/callback direction, not an implicit network request. The documented isolation rules and known implementation deviations are listed in qa-report.md.

slides.title: Available customization

cards.title: Typed content variants
cards.body: Plain text, code, Markdown, PDF, OOXML, media, HTML and MCP views.

cards.title: Optional shared context
cards.body: A canvas provider and its context hook coordinate shared preview state.

cards.title: Host loading hooks
cards.body: loadPdf and configurePdfWorker support caller-controlled PDF setup.

slides.notes: Customization comes from the current exports and prop declarations. Typed content variants: Plain text, code, Markdown, PDF, OOXML, media, HTML and MCP views. Optional shared context: AttachmentCanvasProvider and useAttachmentCanvas coordinate a canvas. Host loading hooks: loadPdf and configurePdfWorker support caller-controlled PDF setup. For UI, import the package stylesheet and use documented props or stable public classes. A component-level color override and inherited theme tokens are different levels of control. Locale strings and direction should be supplied by the host; do not introduce app i18n into a reusable library.

slides.title: Constraints that affect integration

cards.title: Heavy renderers
cards.body: PDF, Office, syntax and MCP dependencies affect packaging; several load lazily.

cards.title: Content errors differ
cards.body: Unsupported, forbidden and failed loads have distinct display states.

cards.title: Untrusted content
cards.body: HTML and MCP views require the documented sandbox and host settings.
